The events your apps send: list the latest, watch them arrive, and choose which are stored.

Usage:
  voidhash events <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  events, event

Commands:
  list       List the project's latest events, newest first.
  tail       Show events as they arrive, until Ctrl+C or --count of them.
  policy     Which events the project stores.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash events <command> --help' for more about a command.
